title: Fix elevated bootstrap SID identity handling
goal: Make the one-time elevated TIA Openness whitelist bootstrap apply the runner user's minimum ACL using a SecurityIdentifier/IdentityReference instead of routing a raw SID string through the account-name overload.
scope: Coding-agent scope is exactly scripts/windows/Configure-TiaV21WorkerWhitelist.ps1 and no other file.
Replace the raw SID-string use in RegistryAccessRule construction with System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier or an equivalent IdentityReference object representing WindowsIdentity.User.
Preserve exact rights SetValue | QueryValues, AccessControlType Allow, InheritanceFlags None, and PropagationFlags None.
Preserve the corrected parenthesized RegistryRights comparison introduced for F010 and keep the script idempotent.
Do not modify src/TiaV21Worker/**, .github/**, agents/**, tasks/**, runner configuration, secrets, parent registry ACLs, generator/domain/compiler code, or IndustrialMDE.

requirements: RegistryAccessRule is constructed with an IdentityReference/SecurityIdentifier for the current runner identity, not a raw SID string passed to the String overload.
ACL scope remains only the TiaV21Worker.exe Entry key.
Granted rights remain exactly SetValue and QueryValues with no inheritance and Allow.
Existing-rule detection remains equivalent and retains the parenthesized combined RegistryRights comparison.
Bootstrap remains idempotent and does not loosen any parent Siemens Openness registry ACL.
No src/TiaV21Worker/** changes and no unrelated files.
Primary connected ChatGPT performs independent exact-SHA CODE_REVIEW because the candidate is authored by the coding agent.
tia: After merge, run scripts/windows/Configure-TiaV21WorkerWhitelist.ps1 elevated on TIA-V21-PC under the same Windows identity used by the self-hosted runner; it must end with Bootstrap completed successfully.
phase:bootstrap-required must not recur and no interactive Openness access (0033:000666) dialog may appear.
OLQ-001 migration PASS is not required; retrieve-with-upgrade remains a separate migration defect if encountered.
